mapper.sql: SELECT iv.*, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.major, s.class_name, l.name AS lab_name, m.name AS mentor_name, a.intro AS application_intro, a.skills AS application_skills FROM interview iv JOIN application a ON a.id = iv.application_id JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = iv.lab_id LEFT JOIN mentor m ON m.id = iv.mentor_id
mapper.select: WHERE iv.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY iv.scheduled_at, iv.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview (batch_id, application_id, lab_id, mentor_id, scheduled_at, location, score, comment, conclusion, status, recorded_by, recorded_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{applicationId}, #{labId}, #{mentorId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{location}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{conclusion}, #{status}, #{recordedBy}, #{recordedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND lab_id = (SELECT lab_id FROM mentor WHERE id = #{mentorId}) AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND lab_id = #{labId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
